# RangeAndFuel.ca — Canadian Automotive Intelligence Platform

> Canada's premier independent authority on automotive fuel consumption (L/100km), electric vehicle range modeling (kWh/100km), provincial energy cost calculations (CAD $), and Transport Canada safety recalls.

## Core Data Standards & Methodologies
- **Fuel Consumption Ratings:** Sourced from Natural Resources Canada (NRCan) EnerGuide 5-cycle laboratory testing (City, Highway, Combined in L/100km or kWh/100km).
- **Provincial Energy Pricing:** Weekly updated petroleum prices (¢/L) and residential electricity tariffs (¢/kWh) across all 10 Canadian provinces (ON, QC, BC, AB, MB, SK, NS, NB, NL, PE).
- **Sub-Zero Winter Modeling (-15°C):** Computational thermodynamic loss models for Battery Electric Vehicles (-32% avg range loss) and Internal Combustion Engines (+15% fuel burn penalty) in Canadian winter climates.
- **Safety Recalls:** Synchronized with Transport Canada’s public Motor Vehicle Safety Recalls (MVSR) database under the Canadian Motor Vehicle Safety Act (MVSA).

## Key Vehicle Directories & Tools
- [Homepage & Interactive Cockpit](https://rangeandfuel.ca/): Multi-province cost calculator, winter penalty meter, head-to-head comparison tool.
- [Vehicle Catalog & Search](https://rangeandfuel.ca/search): Instant multi-attribute search across 80+ vehicle models and 100+ trim levels.
- [Transport Canada Recalls Directory](https://rangeandfuel.ca/recalls): Active defect tracking, CMVSS regulations, and safety notice archives.
- [About Us & Editorial Standards](https://rangeandfuel.ca/about): Editorial independence, human automotive journalism guidelines, fact-checking methodology.
- [Data Methodology & Legal Disclaimer](https://rangeandfuel.ca/disclaimer): Technical breakdown of NRCan 5-cycle testing and 17-digit VIN verification.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rangeandfuel.ca/privacy): Canadian PIPEDA, CASL, Quebec Law 25, and Google AdSense compliance terms.
- [Terms of Service](https://rangeandfuel.ca/terms): Acceptable use, computational estimations, and legal jurisdiction in Ontario, Canada.

## Supported Canadian Vehicle Brands
- **Gasoline, Hybrid & PHEV:** Toyota, Honda, Ford, Chevrolet, GMC, Hyundai, Kia, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Porsche, Lexus, Acura, Subaru, Mazda, Nissan, RAM, Jeep, Lincoln, Cadillac.
- **Pure Battery Electric (BEV):** Tesla, Hyundai Electric, Kia Electric, Rivian, Lucid, Polestar, Genesis EV, Chevrolet EV, Volvo Recharge, Volkswagen ID.4.
